label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: God is supremely good and omnipotent
locator: I q.2 a.3 ad 1: Deus, cum sit summe bonus ... adeo omnipotens et bonus
interpretation: The attributes the reply presupposes, in Augustine's words (Enchiridion 11) as quoted by Aquinas. The attributes are argued for later (ST I qq.4-6, 25); here they are commitments of the theory.
